annotations.title: Approve, skip or edit an action

description: Decide one action: approve, skip or edit its draft. Approving runs it as the product's owner and publishes or sends through the accounts connected on hustlin.ai. Needs the approver role or higher.

content.description: Replacement draft text. Required for edit, optional with approve.

decision.description: approve: ship it now (publishes or sends through connected accounts; manual tasks stay guidance). skip: don't do it. edit: change the draft without approving.
